_comment: Mobile-only strings. Locales/*.json is overwritten wholesale by the mainline extractor, so these live here. Loc.Load overlays them.
_voiceComment: Hwang doesn't explain himself. Short sentences, no reasons given, exact counts. The point of this file is that a quest reads as somebody asking for something, not as a shopping list.
DQ_HWANG_BOLT_01_ACCEPT: Five bolts. Proper spec. Don't bring me what you scraped off the road.
DQ_HWANG_BOLT_01_COMPLETE: These'll do. Keep it up and the work keeps coming.
DQ_HWANG_BANDAGE_01_ACCEPT: Three bandages. Somebody's in a hurry. Don't ask why.
DQ_HWANG_AMMO_01_ACCEPT: Thirty rounds, 5.45. Reloads are fine, long as they don't blow up.
DQ_HWANG_AMMO_01_COMPLETE: Counted them. Thirty. You're good with numbers.
DQ_HWANG_RATION_01_ACCEPT: Food. Any kind. Just not spoiled.
DQ_HWANG_RATION_01_COMPLETE: This goes uptown. Your share's in cash.
DQ_HWANG_METAL_01_ACCEPT: Metal, whatever you've got. Four pieces. Nothing rusted through.
DQ_HWANG_METAL_01_COMPLETE: Weight's right. You'll get your price.
DQ_HWANG_MEDS_01_ACCEPT: I need medicine. Painkillers, anything — as long as it's still labeled.
DQ_HWANG_MEDS_01_COMPLETE: That's worth real money. I paid you proper.
DQ_HWANG_PCB_01_ACCEPT: Five boards. Nothing burnt. The legs have to be on.
DQ_HWANG_PCB_01_COMPLETE: Where did you find these. ...Never mind. Better I don't ask.
DQ_HWANG_RIFLE_01_ACCEPT: One rifle, sixty rounds. Somebody's going out. I don't know who.
DQ_HWANG_RIFLE_01_COMPLETE: Got it. ...If they come back, I'll have them buy you a drink.
_eventComment: Expedition event reports. The same event reads differently depending on who you sent - hence two lines. Written as radio reports: short, flat, factual.
EV_AMBUSH_PASS: Walked into an ambush. Pushed through. Burned some ammo.
EV_AMBUSH_FAIL: Ambush. Dropped the haul and got out.
EV_SURVIVOR_PASS: Brought a survivor back. Hwang says he'll handle it.
EV_SURVIVOR_FAIL: Saw a survivor. Couldn't carry them. ...Left them.
EV_LOCKED_CACHE_PASS: Got the locked cache open. It was full.
EV_LOCKED_CACHE_FAIL: Found a locked cache. Couldn't open it. Marked the spot.
EV_SCRAP_HAUL_PASS: Hauled an abandoned cart back whole.
EV_SCRAP_HAUL_FAIL: Found a cart. Too heavy - took what we could carry.
EV_TOLL_PASS: Crew blocking the road. They moved.
EV_TOLL_FAIL: Crew blocking the road. Paid the toll.
EV_MEDICAL_CACHE_PASS: Dug through a collapsed pharmacy. Found something usable.
EV_MEDICAL_CACHE_FAIL: The pharmacy had already been picked clean.
EV_RADIO_CONTACT_PASS: Picked up a transmission. Got coordinates - Hwang will pay well.
EV_RADIO_CONTACT_FAIL: Picked up a transmission. Just static. Too far out.
DQ_CHOI_BANDAGE_01_ACCEPT: Bring four bandages. Set aside any with wet packaging.
DQ_CHOI_BANDAGE_01_COMPLETE: Clean and dry. These will get us through tonight.
DQ_CHOI_FIRSTAID_01_ACCEPT: I need three first aid kits. Check that nothing is missing.
DQ_CHOI_FIRSTAID_01_COMPLETE: Everything is here. I will take these to the patients.
DQ_CHOI_TAPE_01_ACCEPT: Four rolls of tape and two bandages. We need to secure splints.
DQ_CHOI_TAPE_01_COMPLETE: These will hold when they move. Thank you.
DQ_CHOI_IFAK_01_ACCEPT: Three IFAKs, please. They are for the people heading out.
DQ_CHOI_IFAK_01_COMPLETE: I will give each of them one. I hope they return without needing them.
DQ_CHOI_PAINKILL_01_ACCEPT: Two packs of painkillers and three bandages. Too many people are hurting tonight.
DQ_CHOI_PAINKILL_01_COMPLETE: I will hand out the medicine first. Perhaps they can get some sleep.
DQ_CHOI_TOURNIQUET_01_ACCEPT: Two tourniquets and two first aid kits. We need to be ready for bleeding.
DQ_CHOI_TOURNIQUET_01_COMPLETE: We are ready now. Let us hope we do not need them.
DQ_CHOI_SURGERY_01_ACCEPT: Two Grizzly kits and two IFAKs. I am preparing for a major procedure.
DQ_CHOI_SURGERY_01_COMPLETE: Nothing is missing. I will take it from here.
DQ_KIM_WIRE_01_ACCEPT: Four bundles of wire. Check the copper, not just the insulation.
DQ_KIM_WIRE_01_COMPLETE: Continuity checks out. Enough to redo the wiring.
DQ_KIM_FAN_01_ACCEPT: Two cooling fans and two bundles of wire. No seized bearings.
DQ_KIM_FAN_01_COMPLETE: A little noise is fine. They spin, so they will move the heat.
DQ_KIM_PLUG_01_ACCEPT: Three spark plugs. Check the electrodes for wear first.
DQ_KIM_PLUG_01_COMPLETE: Just need to set the gaps. Good work.
DQ_KIM_PCB_01_ACCEPT: Four circuit boards. Pick ones with intact traces.
DQ_KIM_PCB_01_COMPLETE: Plenty of usable components. Worth taking these apart.
DQ_KIM_CPU_01_ACCEPT: Two processors and two boards. Tell me about bent pins before handing them over.
DQ_KIM_CPU_01_COMPLETE: Pins look good. I will handle powering them up.
DQ_KIM_PSU_01_ACCEPT: Two power supplies and three bundles of wire. Leave anything that smells burnt.
DQ_KIM_PSU_01_COMPLETE: These should restore power. Just the load test left.
DQ_KIM_MOTOR_01_ACCEPT: Two motors and three boards. Check for bent shafts too.
DQ_KIM_MOTOR_01_COMPLETE: Smooth rotation. Now I can fit the controller.

GUIDE_0_BODY: Make supplies for those heading outside and send companions to recover resources. Deliver your employer’s requests to build a foothold in Seoul.
GUIDE_0_TIP: Use the five bottom tabs: Base, Factory, Explore, Personnel and Warehouse. Replay this guide in Settings.
GUIDE_1_BODY: Choose a material-free job at the Factory workbench. In Broken Delivery Network, follow the signal and bank your reward. In Blackout Vault, read the number clues and avoid hazards to recover supplies.
GUIDE_1_TIP: Higher rewards mean higher risk. Banking what you have is a valid choice.
GUIDE_2_BODY: Your work rewards go to the Warehouse. Select an item and quantity to sell for cash. Keep supplies needed for requests so you can deliver them later.
GUIDE_2_TIP: The Base’s next-action guide adapts to your current supplies and money.
GUIDE_3_BODY: Once you have enough money, check hiring costs and equipment in Personnel and recruit one companion. Expeditions require an idle companion with a weapon. Equip and treat companions here too.
GUIDE_3_TIP: Check the current hiring cost and departure requirements on screen.
GUIDE_4_BODY: Select one idle companion in Explore and send the initial supply run. This first mission is free and returns safely after three minutes. Time passes while the app is closed, so you can do something else.
GUIDE_4_TIP: Starting a normal expedition first skips the starter run. Normal expeditions cost money and risk injury or disappearance.
GUIDE_5_TITLE: Base — deliver and build your future
GUIDE_5_BODY: When the supply team returns, deliver the package at Base for 50,000 won. Then craft and explore for supplies, complete daily requests and build trust to expand your reach.
GUIDE_5_TIP: Link to the main game separately from the Base menu. You can start playing without signing in.
동료에게 무기 지급: Equip a worker with a weapon
First, choose free delivery network hacking or a vault search in the factory. Let us gather your first supplies.
이제 작업 버튼을 눌러 화면의 지시에 따라 한 공정씩 완료하세요. 마지막: Press the work button and follow the on-screen instructions, one stage at a time. After the last stage, the supplies enter your warehouse.
출발 전 무기가 필요합니다. 인원에서 동료의 장비를 열고 무기를 구매·지: You need a weapon before departing. Open a worker’s equipment in Personnel, then buy and equip a weapon.
탐색에서 무기를 든 동료 한 명을 선택하고 ‘보급 꾸러미 회수하러 출발’: In Explore, select one armed worker and send them to collect the supply package. The first expedition is free and returns safely in 3 minutes.
동료가 보급품을 회수하고 있습니다. 돌아올 때까지 공장에서 제작해 보세요: Your worker is collecting supplies. Try crafting in the factory while you wait. I will explain the next step when they return.
보급품이 도착했습니다. 기지의 ‘꾸러미 납품’을 눌러 첫 임무 보상 50: The supplies have arrived. Deliver the package at the base to receive your first mission reward of ₩50,000.
Check today’s orders for the supplies you need and prepare the next trade.
Failing another attempt loses the bonus supplies.
Keep the marker in the bright area.
Keep the marker in the bright area to collect supplies.
방금 나온 숫자 {0} = 주변 8칸의 위험 개수: Number {0}: hazards among the 8 neighboring boxes
Numbers count nearby hazards. Try next to a 0.
Open any box. The first one is safe.
Find safe boxes to collect supplies.
Losing connection! Return to the bright area.
위험 발견 · 기본 물자 {0}만 가져왔어요: Hazard found · collected only base supplies: {0}
Hold the button to move the marker right. Release to move left.
밝은 구간 안에 머물면 물자를 모읍니다. 밖에 오래 있으면 연결이 끊깁니: Stay in the bright area to collect supplies. Stay outside too long and the connection breaks.
물자를 모으면 지금 받거나 더 도전할 수 있습니다. 실패하면 추가 물자는: Once supplies are ready, collect them or try for more. Failure loses the bonus, but you still receive the base supplies.
Tap a closed box to open it. Your first box is always safe.
열린 상자의 숫자는 주변 8칸의 위험 개수입니다. 0 옆은 안전하고, 숫: The number in an opened box counts hazards in its 8 neighbors. Boxes next to a 0 are safe. Larger numbers mean more hazards nearby.
안전한 상자 3개부터 물자를 받을 수 있습니다. 더 열면 보상이 늘지만: Find 3 safe boxes to collect supplies. Opening more can increase the reward, but a hazard loses the bonus. You can use Safe opening twice.
Hold the work button to fill the bar.
Release when the bar reaches the bright area.
가운데에 가깝게 맞출수록 좋은 품질이 나옵니다. 구간을 넘기기 전에 떼는: Aim near the center for better quality. Release before you go past the target area.
Items appear one at a time. Watch them carefully.
Press the work button when a defective item appears. Let good items pass.
Spot defects quickly for better quality.
The marker moves left and right. Watch the bright area.
Press the work button when the marker enters the bright area.
Aim near the center for better quality. Take your time.
1. 무기를 착용하고 물·음식·치료제를 챙기세요. 한 지역은 6~10개: 1. Equip a weapon and pack water, food, and medicine. Each area has 6–10 sections.
2. 적이 조준할 때 엄폐하고 재장전할 때 공격하세요. 날씨 효과는 적에: 2. Take cover when enemies aim and attack while they reload. Weather affects both sides equally.
3. 이동은 수분과 에너지를 소모합니다. 탈출구가 보이면 전리품을 챙겨: 3. Moving uses hydration and energy. Take an exit to return with your loot.
4. 사망·긴급 귀환 시 이번 전리품을 잃습니다. 캐릭터 레벨은 현재 표: 4. Death or emergency return loses this run's loot. Character level is currently display-only and does not affect stats.
가까운 곳에서 발소리가 들립니다. 어떻게 할까요?: Footsteps nearby. What will you do?
간신히 구해 왔다. 장비는 챙겨 뒀으니 쉬어라. 다음에는 무리하지 말고: Barely got you out. Your gear is safe, so rest. Next time, know your way out and don't push your luck.
기지에서 치료와 식사를 먼저 하세요: Heal and eat at base first
내가 데려와서 응급처치를 했어요. 다음에는 몸 상태를 보고, 늦기 전에: I brought you back and treated you. Next time, watch your condition and return before it's too late.
Tap to add one. Supplies leave the warehouse when you depart.
You made it back. Sort your haul and get some rest.
문이 열린 건물을 발견했습니다. 안에 물자가 있을까요?: An open building. Could there be supplies inside?
발소리를 따라 습격하거나, 숨어서 위험을 피할 수 있어요. 매장과 빈집에: Ambush whoever is making those footsteps, or hide to avoid danger. Search shops and empty homes for supplies.
비 · 서로 발소리를 듣기 어렵습니다: Rain · Footsteps are harder for both sides to hear
Choose supplies to use. Enemies keep moving while you heal.
Tap an item for its description and available actions.
안개 · 양쪽 모두 명중률 감소: Fog · Accuracy reduced for both sides
Low energy. Eat or request an emergency return.
연락이 끊겨서 직접 찾아갔잖아. 물건보다 네 목숨이 먼저야. 다음엔 조심: You went silent, so I came looking. Your life matters more than loot. Be careful next time.
이 지역에 스캐브가 파견 중입니다: A scav is deployed in this area
이동할 때 수분과 에너지를 씁니다. 탈출구가 보이면 물건을 챙겨 안전하게: Moving uses hydration and energy. Take an exit to return safely with your items. Death or emergency return loses this run's loot.
이번에 얻은 전리품을 포기하고 구조를 요청합니다. 장착 장비는 보존됩니다: Abandon this run's loot and request rescue. Equipped gear is kept.
장비 칸을 눌러 무기를 착용하세요. 치료제와 물·음식은 ‘가져갈 물자’에: Tap an equipment slot to equip a weapon. Pack medicine, water, and food under Pack supplies. Choose an area when ready.
Equipped gear and unused starting supplies are kept.
The enemy took cover. Time to recover.
적이 부상으로 비틀거립니다!: The enemy is staggering from a wound!
적이 재장전 중입니다. 공격할 기회!: The enemy is reloading. Attack now!
적이 조준하면 사격 전에 엄폐하세요. 재장전하거나 부상당했을 때 공격할: Take cover before an aiming enemy fires. Attack when they reload or stagger. Opening the item menu pauses combat, but starting treatment resumes it.
The enemy is watching the area.
적이 총을 겨눕니다! 엄폐하세요 · {0:0.0}초: The enemy is aiming! Take cover · {0:0.0}s
적이 총을 들면 엄폐하세요: Take cover when the enemy raises their gun
주변에 물자가 남아 있습니다. 살펴볼까요?: Supplies remain nearby. Take a look?
Unavailable now. Check your gear and remaining supplies.
진행 중인 탐색 결과를 먼저 확인하세요: Review the current exploration result first
Progress is paused. Please try saving again.
창고에 들어가지 못한 물자는 안전하게 보관 중입니다. 준비 화면에서 수령: Supplies that did not fit in the warehouse are stored safely. Collect them on the preparation screen.
창고의 장비를 골라 착용하세요. 사용 중인 장비는 다른 인원과 공유할 수: Choose gear from the warehouse. Equipped gear cannot be shared with other personnel.
총기 또는 근접 무기를 장착하세요: Equip a firearm or melee weapon
An exit is in sight. You can keep everything you've found.
탈출하면 가져갈 물건: Items to bring back on extraction
Exploration is paused. You can resume here even after closing the app.
NPC에게 첫 탐색 장비 받기: Get your first exploration kit from the NPC
터치하면 물자 1개, 탄약은 10발씩 담습니다. 출발할 때 창고에서 가져: Tap to pack one supply item or 10 rounds. Supplies leave the warehouse when you depart.
장비를 챙기고 서울로 · 물자를 찾아 무사히 돌아오세요: Gear up for Seoul · Find supplies and return alive
맨손으로 나가겠다는 건 아니겠지. 동대문 최씨에게 넘겨받은 권총이다. 탄: You are not heading out unarmed. This pistol came from Choi in Dongdaemun. I am issuing ammunition with it. Supplies can be replaced. You come back alive.
밖으로 나가셔야 한다면, 몸을 지킬 수단은 있어야겠어요. 동대문 최 사장: If you must go outside, you need a way to protect yourself. I asked Mr. Choi in Dongdaemun for this pistol. I packed medicine and food too. If you get hurt, please come back instead of enduring it.
최씨가 가져온 권총인데, 내가 작동은 확인해 뒀어. 처음부터 비싼 총 찾: Choi brought this pistol in. I checked that it works. No need for an expensive gun right away. Start with this, and tell me what gave you trouble when you return. Getting you back matters more than the gun.
나가시기 전에 잠깐 들러 주세요. 몸을 지킬 물건과 드실 것을 챙겨 드릴: Please stop by before you leave. I will prepare something to protect you, and some food.
나가기 전에 작업대 쪽으로 와. 네 손에 맞을 만한 권총 하나 손봐 뒀어: Come by the workbench before you leave. I fixed up a pistol that should suit you.
Collect your supplies before departure. I am not sending you out unarmed.
권총은 착용해 두었어요. 약과 물도 확인하셨나요? 아래에서 명동을 선택하: Your pistol is equipped. Have you checked your medicine and water? Select Myeongdong below. Please do not push yourself.
권총은 바로 쓸 수 있게 해 뒀어. 탄약 맞는지 확인하고, 아래에서 명동: The pistol is ready to use. Check your ammunition, then choose Myeongdong below. Let me look it over when you get back.
권총 착용 확인. 탄약과 보급품을 점검하고 아래에서 명동을 선택해라. 첫: Pistol equipped. Check ammunition and supplies, then select Myeongdong below. Your first objective is to return safely.
전리품을 탐색 가방에 넣었습니다. 안전하게 탈출해야 기지로 가져갈 수 있: Loot is in your exploration bag. Extract safely to bring it back to base.
권총은 착용해 두었어요. 약과 물도 확인하셨나요? 아래에서 용산 전자상가: Your pistol is equipped. Have you checked your medicine and water? Select Yongsan Electronics Market below. Please do not push yourself.
권총은 바로 쓸 수 있게 해 뒀어. 탄약 맞는지 확인하고, 아래에서 용산: The pistol is ready to use. Check your ammunition, then choose Yongsan Electronics Market below. Let me look it over when you get back.
권총 착용 확인. 탄약과 보급품을 점검하고 아래에서 용산 전자상가을 선택: Pistol equipped. Check ammunition and supplies, then select Yongsan Electronics Market below. Your first objective is to return safely.
Parts and tools for repairs are inside.
Medical supplies for first aid are inside.
Choose the weapon or equipment you need from this stash.
Check that the ammunition fits your weapon before taking it.
Some valuables worth trading remain in the safe.
A few supplies remain in the pocket of an abandoned coat.
주민들을 위한 첫 왕진 준비: Preparing for the first house call
쓸모를 증명하는 첫 보급: A first supply run to prove yourself
서울에 남으시기로 했군요. 이곳 주민들도 아직 도움이 필요해요. 용산 전: You have decided to stay in Seoul. The people here still need help. Could you look around Yongsan Electronics Market and check whether any usable supplies remain in the medical crates? Choose one to bring back, and use it if you need to. Come back safely and tell me what you found.
남아서 버틸 거면 고쳐 쓸 줄도 알아야지. 용산 전자상가 공구 상자에 쓸: If you are staying, you need to know how to fix things. Check the toolboxes at Yongsan Electronics Market for usable materials. Pick something up and tell me what you found when you get back. Getting you home alive matters more than the goods.
서울에 남겠다고? 그럼 네 몫을 해라. 용산 전자상가의 포켓을 뒤져 쓸: Staying in Seoul? Then do your share. Search the pockets at Yongsan Electronics Market for usable supplies. Choose one and recover it. Use it in the field if necessary. Combat is not the objective. Return alive and report your findings. Then I will judge your worth.
용산 전자상가 의료 상자 수색 → 물품 선택 → 생존 귀환 → 보건의 최: Search a medical crate at Yongsan Electronics Market → choose an item → return alive → report to Dr. Choi
용산 전자상가 공구 상자 수색 → 물품 선택 → 생존 귀환 → 용산 김씨: Search a toolbox at Yongsan Electronics Market → choose an item → return alive → report to Yongsan Kim
용산 전자상가 포켓 수색 → 물품 선택 → 생존 귀환 → 황 상사에게 보: Search a pocket at Yongsan Electronics Market → choose an item → return alive → report to Hwang
무사히 돌아오셔서 다행이에요. 살펴봐 주신 덕분에 주민들께 필요한 물자를: I am glad you made it back safely. Thanks to your survey, we can prepare the supplies our residents need. Here is your promised payment. Take care of yourself today.
그런 재료가 남아 있었다고? 좋아, 어디를 뒤져야 할지 알겠네. 물건 보: Those materials were still there? Good. Now I know where to look. You have an eye for useful things. Here is your pay. Let me know if you spot anything else worth using. Just do not push your luck.
물자 수색 보고, 생존 복귀 확인. 첫 임무는 합격이다. 보수를 지급하겠: Supply survey received. Safe return confirmed. You passed your first assignment. Payment approved. Remember this next time: your return comes before the supplies.
눈에 띄는 물건부터 챙기기: Grab the first item you spot
Stay alert and take just one. Choose what you need.
익숙한 거리의 불빛이 하나둘 꺼졌다. 연락은 끊기고, 서울의 일상은 무너: The lights on familiar streets went out one by one. Contact was lost, and everyday life in Seoul fell apart. I am an ordinary resident who has lived in this city.
도시가 다시 안정을 찾을 때까지, 나는 서울에 남기로 했다. 오늘을 버티: I decided to stay in Seoul until the city finds stability again. Get through today and survive tomorrow. For now, that is where I start.
남은 물과 식량은 얼마 없다. 약도, 고장 난 물건을 고칠 공구도 필요하: There is little food or water left. I need medicine and tools to fix what is broken. There is only so much I can gather alone.
골목에서 만난 약탈자들에게 소문을 들었다. 군수 창고의 황 상사, 진료소: Looters I met in an alley shared a rumor: Hwang at the supply depot, Dr. Choi at the clinic, and Yongsan Kim. People with influence in this city. Who should I seek out first?
I cannot last long alone.
Time to find people who know supplies and have connections.
누구를 먼저 찾아갈까: Who should I seek out first?
